name: Kanade
source:
The protagonist is the son of the head of a large organization.
He's been living his life responsibility-free on the vast estate his family owns.
One day, he suddenly receives word that his father has passed away.

Before he can even let the news sink in, he is confronted with the responsibility of being his successor.
Furthermore, when he talks to his mother about the situation, something seems off...

"Our family is part of a long line of demons who've used their talents to make a fortune in the sex industry."
"Just like your father, incubus blood runs through your veins."
"That's why it's up to you to take the reins of this household. If you don't fulfill your duty and become an exceptional incubus, we'll be in a bit of a pickle."

To become fully qualified to be the head of this house, the protagonist must first become the best incubus he can be.
Being a good incubus will mean charming, capturing, and fucking as many women as possible. It all comes down to his dick.
He's in a wildly tight spot, but lucky for him, his succu-maids are more than willing to put together a slutty sex education program and get right down to teaching.
Will their efforts be enough?!
